purpose: Teach: 燃やし/とうてい/しかるべき/思い通り/のべ/いちおう/かならず/みごと

lines.speaker: mei_romantic
lines.jp: 葵、お庭の枯れ枝を燃やしたい所ね、メイちゃん
lines.en: Aoi, I'd love to burn those dry branches from the garden sometime soon.
lines.style: Thoughtful, gently reflective. Soft, almost dreamy opening. Warm but measured pace. Trailing off slightly, like she's imagining the scene.

lines.speaker: aoi_barista
lines.jp: 葵、来週までにはとうてい新メニューが出来ないわ、メイちゃん
lines.en: Aoi, there's no way I can have the new menu ready by next week.
lines.style: Dry, matter-of-fact. A slight edge of exasperation underneath. Steady pace, not defensive. The tone of someone stating an obvious fact.

lines.speaker: mei_romantic
lines.jp: 葵、お客様には、しかるべき対応をしましょうね、メイちゃん
lines.en: Aoi, let's make sure we handle our customers with the care they deserve.
lines.style: Gentle guidance, not a command. Steady, assured tone. Warm but purposeful. The cadence of someone offering direction as support.

lines.speaker: aoi_barista
lines.jp: 葵、新メニューは、思い通りに仕上がったわよ、メイちゃん
lines.en: Aoi, the new menu turned out exactly as I'd hoped.
lines.style: Quiet satisfaction underlying the words. Slight lift in tone, but controlled. A small smile in the voice. Pride without boasting.

lines.speaker: mei_romantic
lines.jp: 葵、お客様はのべ五十人お見えになったわよ、メイちゃん
lines.en: Aoi, we had fifty customers in total today.
lines.style: Warmth and quiet pride in the announcement. Steady, deliberate pace. A gentle emphasis on the number—not bragging, just acknowledging something good.

lines.speaker: aoi_barista
lines.jp: 葵、いちおう新人さんに伝えておいたわ、メイちゃん
lines.en: Aoi, I made sure to brief the new staff member on everything.
lines.style: Matter-of-fact, slightly practical. A touch of dutiful completion in the tone. Not proud, just reporting what was done. Steady, almost businesslike.

lines.speaker: mei_romantic
lines.jp: 葵、明日はかならずお店に出るわね、メイちゃん
lines.en: Aoi, I'll definitely be at the shop tomorrow.
lines.style: Firm, reassuring commitment. Clear and direct. A note of determination underneath—someone making a promise and meaning it.

lines.speaker: aoi_barista
lines.jp: 葵、お客様のラテアート、みごとにお褒めいただいた、メイちゃん
lines.en: Aoi, the customers really praised the latte art beautifully.
lines.style: Warm, genuine pleasure. Soft opening, slight lift at 'beautifully.' Trailing off with quiet contentment. The tone of someone genuinely delighted by someone else's success.
